slides.sub: Paying daily may cost you more than you think. Swipe before you pay.

slides.title: Convent Station
slides.body: Convent Station is on NJ Transit's Morristown Line. The ticket office is open weekdays, 6 AM to 1:30 PM. On weekends, use the ticket machine or the NJ Transit app.
slides.source: NJ Transit, Convent Station; Morris Township (Nov. 2026)

slides.title: $5 a day
slides.body: Daily meters cost $5, weekends and holidays included. Pay at the pay station, or use mPay2Park (zone 10701) for an extra $0.30.

slides.title: $345 a year
slides.body: A resident permit is $345 a year, July to June. That's 69 days at the meter. Non-residents pay $690. A permit doesn't guarantee a space.
slides.source: Morris Township, Resident & Non-Resident Permit Parking (Nov. 2026)

slides.title: Your Convent Station morning
slides.tip: Before you offer, drive to the station at rush hour and see how early the lot fills.
